revision_note: Targeted gap-successor sweep linked through catalogue revision 4. Existing exact incoming-promotion node now indexes completed family/software bindings and the scoped free-seed obstruction. No proof outcomes, statements or executable frontier changed.
outcome_policy: Use research/conjecture_net/outcome_reference.py semantics, not signed-arrow composition. Each attempt targets its node's exact statement and scope_id. ++ and -+ decide that scoped proposition only; +- and -- do not decide truth. null means no concluded local attempt, not a failed attempt. status/verdict retain workflow/history information and do not replace outcomes. Inspected prior-result nodes have null local outcomes: no cross-net proof import is manufactured. Such imports require the shared pinned outcome-reference protocol.

operator_stimulus.wording: Any known physical law's domain, is a cut of marici tower, that exposes that domain as the formed triangle, represented as FCC or equivalent tetrahedral
operator_stimulus.wording_status: Historical original wording; superseded in part by the operator clarification below.
operator_stimulus.current_wording: Any known physical law's domain is represented by a cut in an admissible representation of the Marici tower.
operator_stimulus.clarification: Cuts may be taken in any admissible representation of the same Marici tower. No formed-triangle, FCC, tetrahedral or retained-record format is privileged or required. Intrinsic-triangle and physical-face branches remain optional stronger claims. The quantifier and admissibility boundary are stated separately below.
operator_stimulus.epistemic_status: non-evidential search direction; operator authorized creation and parent wiring
operator_stimulus.context: The tower is sequential serialization/deserialization of a WG-generated system. QM can exist throughout; laws are not assigned exclusive rungs.
prohibited_substitutions: Replace the conjecture by relations between cuts.
Replace a WG-generated system by an arbitrary external system and make universality a preliminary gate.
Replace the governing claim by a catalogue of successful examples.
Interpret serialization order as physical scale or time without sector-specific data.

objective.statement: Any known physical law's domain is represented by a cut in an admissible representation of the Marici tower.
objective.claim_boundary: A conjecture about domains of laws, not a theorem from drawing a triangle, a literal crystal assertion, or unique selection of present physics. The three initial cases test the same claim; they do not exhaust it.

representation_scope.quantifier: For each intended known physical-law domain D, there exist an admissible representation R of the same Marici tower, an admissible cut C in R, and a structure-preserving comparison between D and C.
representation_scope.any_representation_means: No representation family is privileged. This does not assert that every representation contains every domain, or that every cut is a physical-law domain.
definition_obligations: Identify the tower/source structure being represented and the structure its representation maps must preserve.
Specify the allowed cut operations in each admitted representation, rather than treating stage selection, fiber restriction and projection as identical by name.
Specify the domain comparison and the operations, constraints and observations it must preserve.
representation_scope.anti_vacuity: Representation admission must be justified from the tower by criteria independent of the desired domain match; arbitrary encoding of a supplied physical answer is not by itself a tower representation witness.
representation_scope.representation_change: When an admitted equivalence carries the chosen cut operation and required domain structure, corresponding cuts should yield equivalent domains. Arbitrary equivalences, lossy projections and all cuts are not automatically covered by this conditional principle.
representation_scope.boundary: These are explicit formulation obligations and scope conventions, not completed theorems or an executable conjecture to investigate. Removing privileged geometry does not resolve them.

issue_boundary.problem: Determine whether physical-law domains are realized by admissible cuts across admissible representations of the same Marici tower, without fixing a presentation geometry.

rivals.statement: An encoding exists, but has no independently justified status as a representation and cut of the specified tower.
Such cuts expose some domains, but an existing physical domain requires retained structure no such cut carries.
The physical domain is inserted as a free interpretation rather than exposed by the tower operation.

risky_consequences: Berry transport must retain the transition and loop data needed to distinguish the existing phase-loss counterexample.
A lossy-response domain must account for the bath/noise contribution required by the canonical commutator.
Anomaly inflow must retain the quantized level and relational orientation, not manufacture an absolute sign by hiding a reference choice.
A proposed representation and cut must preserve the structure needed to state and apply the law; a drawing or arbitrary packet encoding alone does not establish tower admission.

attempt_protocol.source: C2 rank-one orthogonal projector P:[0,1]->End(C^n), finite n, with P(0)=P(1); ordered partitions 0=t0<...<tm=1.
attempt_protocol.target: Canonical projector-induced Berry holonomy, convention A=-i u^dagger du and phase exp(i integral A), with endpoint frame transition retained.
attempt_protocol.comparison: For z_pi=Tr(P(t0)...P(t_(m-1))), use H_pi=z_pi/|z_pi| whenever z_pi is nonzero; compare H_pi with the independently defined canonical holonomy. Rank-one cyclic trace is the frame-invariant normalized overlap product, not an independently supplied answer phase.
attempt_protocol.protocol: Prove adjacent overlaps eventually nonzero from a derivative bound and compactness. Derive the local overlap-versus-parallel-transport error and sum it to a loop-dependent bound C(P)*mesh(pi) for sufficiently fine partitions. Retain cyclic endpoint transition, then use established finite readout preservation for each partition. A finite mesh census is insufficient.
attempt_protocol.success: An all-refinement convergence proof in the frozen class plus the retained-readout comparison. This yields ++ only for this Berry node.
attempt_protocol.counterexample: A C2 closed rank-one loop and mesh-zero partition sequence with a different limit or no convergence, under the same phase convention.
attempt_protocol.failure_policy: Failure to obtain the proposed quantitative bound alone is not refutation of convergence. Record +- only when this bounded prove attempt concludes without proving its stated node; no outcome is recorded while merely planned.
